verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents a dedicated developer API platform covering cards, payments, transactions, and expense data (jeeves-docs-7), with specific endpoints like POST /v1/cards/transactions, the Boleto API, mTLS/OAuth2 auth, and webhooks (jeeves-docs-8,9,10,11,12), plus one-click sync to accounting systems like NetSuite/QuickBooks/Xero (jeeves-docs-16,46) — this supports viewing/managing spend-adjacent accounting data programmatically. However, probes found the actual OpenAPI spec and llms.txt at the API docs host return 404s, meaning the API's machine-readable contract could not be independently verified, and there's no explicit 'accounting data' endpoint beyond transactions/cards/expense/bill-pay. Missing for 10: verifiable OpenAPI/spec access, explicit accounting-ledger-style endpoints, and independent/hands-on confirmation of API usability.
